topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I woke up to an eerie silence, the spot in the driveway where my car usually sits, now empty. No note, no sign, nothing to explain why it was gone. I called around, my voice growing more hoarse with each unanswered question. Eventually, I learned it had been towed for reasons that still aren’t clear. Now, I'm left with the echo of the driveway’s emptiness and the looming cost to bring my car back home. The day feels longer, colder, without the familiar presence of my car.
